correctness.rationale: The contraction identity identifies exactly the hub-zero adjacency eigenspaces as nondecaying. Three arm Dirichlet spectra intersect precisely on rational sine frequencies with gcd-defined counts; the hub cancellation constraint has codimension one per common energy. Orthogonal projection of the leaf has the stated normalized sine weight, whose exact root-of-unity sum yields the rational formula and positivity criterion. The algebra was independently checked against 492 full finite adjacency diagonalizations (maximum difference 1.443e-15), 24 exact rational Krylov-rank computations and 21 dissipative eigenvalue tests. These computations corroborate, but do not replace, the finite-dimensional proof for all lengths.

value.rationale: The theorem completely classifies a physically natural three-arm absorber system for all positive integral arm lengths, including the full number of dark modes and exact source-specific survival fraction. The arithmetic cancellation from pairwise and triple Dirichlet coincidences distinguishes length triples with perfect trapping at a leaf from those with persistent modes, even when the graph has dark states elsewhere. Exact quantitative all-size classification is materially more useful than a generic projection algorithm or an arbitrary small finite computation.
